_comment: Tier-2 for febio::rigid_body#1. <dof>Rz</dof> on a rigid_displacement gives 'tag "dof" (line N) : invalid value: Rz'; <dof>u</dof> on a rigid_rotation gives 'tag "dof" (line N) : invalid value: u'. The fixture requires the QUOTED VALUE to be the string it supplied, so the assertion cannot be satisfied by any other parse error. Positive control: the shipped template, unmodified, which reaches normal termination. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'rigid_dof_spelling=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
